$comment: Living ledger of fast-moving public metrics. Read METRICS_TRUTH.md before editing. Every metric MUST carry value, last_verified (ISO date), and source.

$schema_note.shape: metrics.<metric_key> = { value, last_verified (YYYY-MM-DD), source, ownership?, stale?, notes? }

registered_agents.source: scripts/check-agent-harness.mjs and test/v87-agent-registry.test.ts (agents/*.md plus one sub-tier, excluding registry indexes)
registered_agents.notes: Every derived agent file is also required to appear in agents/AGENT_REGISTRY.md. Site and docs fail closed on drift.

skill_activation_rules.notes: Matches skill_definitions_dir_format + skill_definitions_flat_format exactly (35 + 53 = 88). Four Foundry skills were added as portable directory packages.

skill_definitions_flat_format.notes: Skills defined as a single flat file skills/{domain}/{skill-name}.md — the repo uses a mixed layout, both formats are canonical.

starlight_vaults.notes: Public vault count only. Private ~/.starlight/ categories (strategic, technical, creative, operational, wisdom, horizon) are not public vaults.

horizon_letters.notes: Append-only public letters in the Horizon vault.
